competences.description: Attacks the enemy to increase the chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Plays a song that decreases the HP of the enemy that gets a turn by 5% each and decreases the Attack Power for 1 turn with a 75% chance until the next turn starts. You become immune to inability effects, your Attack Speed gets slowed down by half and you cannot attack together or counterattack while playing the song.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be decreased by 50%.
The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.

competences.description: Plays a song that increases the Attack Bar of all allies, excluding yourself, by 15% each and then recovers the HP of the ally that gets a turn by 15% each and increases the Attack Power for 1 turn until the next turn starts. You become immune to inability effects, your Attack Speed gets slowed down by half and you cannot attack together or counterattack while playing the song.

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: Excluding self, applied when ally takes a turn.
Excluding self, applied when ally takes a turn.

effets.description: The target's Attack Power will be increased by 50%.
effets.note: Excluding self, applied when ally takes a turn.

effets.description: The target's Attack Speed will be decreased by 30%.
